Hollow Knight achievements, ticked from your save

Hollow Knight has 63 achievements: 52 from the base game, 2 from Hidden Dreams, 3 from The Grimm Troupe and 6 from Godmaster. 25 of them are hidden until you earn them; here every one shows its name and the game's text, grouped as the wiki groups them: charms, masks, vessels, bosses, essence, grubs, stag stations, characters, challenges, endings and the three content packs.

Achievements belong to your Steam account, not to a save: give the site the file Steam keeps them in on your computer and you'll see your account's, each with its date. Apart from that, import your save and the site says which ones it fulfils, with the thresholds of the game's own code: 20 charms for Enchanted, 23 grubs for Grubfriend, 4 Stag Stations for Connection and the 13 area maps for Cartographer. Ten are awarded at an ending, with the time and the completion of that moment, which the save doesn't keep: the site rules out what it can, settles what it can (a game finished in under 5 hours has Speedrun 2) and, without Steam, you mark the rest.

Questions

I have 112% but not the Pure Completion achievement

Pure Completion asks for 112% and then finishing the game: it's awarded at an ending's credits, with the completion of that moment. Reach 112% and beat an ending again.

Can the site see my Steam achievements?

Yes, from the file Steam keeps on your computer (appcache/stats/UserGameStats_…_367520.bin): pick it or drop it on the tab and it's read in your browser, sent nowhere. Achievements belong to the account, not to a save, so the site shows them apart from what each save fulfils.

Which achievements don't fit in one save?

The Nailsmith's two (Purity and Happy Couple) and the Grimm Troupe's last two (Ritual and Banishment) exclude each other. And Steel Soul, Steel Heart and the speedruns ask for a game played for them.
